question: Which compound did FTIR suggest forms as a unique component of the 300 °C–300 °C multilayer urea crystal, and in what temperature range does TGA show the extra mass-loss step attributed to it?
rendered:
Based on the documents provided, the compound that FTIR suggested forms as a unique component of the 300 °C–300 °C multilayer urea crystal is cyanuric acid (CYA). 

TGA shows the extra mass-loss step attributed to CYA in the 200−250 °C range.
